priorityList: Cast Divine Storm if you have 5 Holy Power
Cast Blade of Justice with an Art of War proc
Cast Final Verdict if you have Empyrean Legacy active
Cast Templar Strikes or Templar Slash
Generating and spending Holy Power comprises the majority of your damage
Do not waste Holy Power by generating it above the level you need
Use Blade to avoid wasting procs
Use Avenging Wrath as soon as it comes up as it is usually the best option
Delay Avenging Wrath slightly in order for cooldowns to line up
Hold Avenging Wrath for mechanics or extra add spawns when better overall
